title: P2.13a-release Bind the release subject to the generated contract digest
description: Close the generated fan-out omission from publishing events.resume. The committed generated control-room client and release subject disagree on the runtime contract digest, so production release admission refuses and two distribution inventory tests fail. Resolve the release subject from the authoritative generated contract digest without creating a second stale constant.
definitionOfDone: A plain Node probe shows the release subject and generated control-room client carry the same current contract digest and returns an accepted six-component subject.
The production release path consumes the authoritative digest or a generated artifact whose determinism is pinned; no independent hand-maintained digest may silently drift.
The two canonical distribution-subject acceptance tests pass from an exact clean commit, with nonzero focused counts and an explicit parent-vs-child failure comparison.

A mutation changing only the generated contract digest makes a named release compatibility assertion fail with CONTROL_ROOM_COMPATIBILITY_REFUSED at RELEASE_SUPPLY_CHAIN, then is restored by byte hash.
Repo release typecheck and focused integration/distribution gates run on committed bytes; unrelated Windows broker failures are disclosed separately.
